intent: Integration tests for Bedrock's Query command: malformed/missing/unterminated queries, single- and multi-statement execution, the no-WHERE DELETE guard, and SQLite's percentile/median aggregate functions.

misfits.why: verifies SQLite's built-in SQLITE_ENABLE_PERCENTILE aggregate functions (median/percentile/percentile_cont/percentile_disc) rather than anything specific to Bedrock's own Query command handling - effectively a build-flag/compiled-in-extension check riding on this fixture
